# DocProEditor

DocProEditor is an online workspace for creating, editing, converting, and sharing documents, presentations, flowcharts, resumes, and PDF files.

## Core Features
- **Document Editor**: Full-featured rich text editing with multi-page paginated sheets, customizable typography, mathematical formulas (LaTeX / KaTeX), tables, borders, and Markdown/HTML/PDF exports.
- **Presentation Maker**: Slide deck creator with slide layouts, geometric shapes, speaker notes, and presentation mode.
- **Flowchart Studio**: Touch-friendly SVG diagramming canvas with node connectors and workflow modeling.
- **Resume Builder**: Professional ATS-friendly resume creation with real-time formatting.
- **PDF Tools**: In-browser PDF editing, merging, splitting, OCR text extraction, and document conversion.
